01-launcher:
Design one native macOS DontsTool launcher state as a desktop screenshot, an implementable UI mockup for an existing Swift/AppKit app. All interface copy must be Simplified Chinese. Follow the project's Quiet Native design system exactly. PLATFORM: native macOS desktop, represented in HTML only as a design deliverable. Render a single 640×420 launcher panel on a 1280×900 desktop canvas; internal list can scroll. Native utility density, restrained presentation. No website header, hero, marketing copy, account, chatbot, dashboard, plugins or editor preview panes. Never place traffic light controls on the launcher. Fixed integrated search header, result area, fixed keyboard-hint footer. The UI should feel built for quick keyboard use. 
SCREEN: 01 — 启动器 · 常用与工具, empty query / initial hotkey invocation.
PAGE STRUCTURE:
1. Search header with magnifier, placeholder “搜索应用、文件或输入关键词…”, discreet “⌥ Space” shortcut capsule at the right, and an accessible settings gear.
2. Internally scrollable result list with group “常用”. Four 48pt app rows: Safari, 访达, 终端, Xcode. Use recognizable simple native-like vector app icons, original app names, subtitle “应用程序” or concise location. Safari is keyboard-selected and shows “打开 ↵” on the right. Include selection focus clearly.
3. Group “工具” with two initially visible compact result rows, not a grid: “格式化 JSON” with command keycap “json”, subtitle “输入内容，或执行时使用剪贴板”; “翻译文本” keycap “tr”, subtitle “自动识别语言”. Additional commands can be revealed by scrolling. Preserve the 420pt height rather than growing window.
4. Fixed bottom status area: a small DontsTool glyph and product name on left, “↑↓ 选择  ↵ 执行  esc 关闭” keycaps on right. No fabricated live counts or speed.
Interactions in exported HTML: focus search on load, arrow-key row selection; keep title and subtitle hierarchy legible. Settings gear is secondary.
Outside the app no other windows, annotations, macOS menu bar or decorative labels. This is an actual compact product screen, not a landing page.

SCREEN: 02 — 搜索 · 应用与文件. Search field contains “note” with insertion cursor.
PAGE STRUCTURE:
1. Integrated search header, magnifier and “note”, small clear button and settings gear.
2. Compact group label “应用 · 2”. First unselected row: “备忘录” (Apple Notes), subtitle “Notes · 应用程序”, right action “打开 ↵”; second row “Notion”, subtitle “应用程序”. Both show recognizable app icons.
3. Group label “文件 · 3”. Three results: “notes.md”, subtitle “~/Documents/Projects/DontsTool”; “Meeting Notes.pdf”, subtitle “~/Documents/Work”; “note-ideas.txt”, subtitle “~/Desktop”. Use document-type vector icons. Result title matches may be emphasized sparingly. Show only genuine action labels, no match percentages, no fake performance stats.
4. Fixed footer: left concise secondary-action hint “⌘↵ 在 Finder 中显示” when the selected item is a file; in the initial screenshot select the file notes.md to make this state clear instead of the app row. Only one selected row. Right shows “↑↓ 选择  ↵ 打开  esc 关闭”.
No browser fallback while local matches exist. No permanent tabs, app grid, side preview pane, status progress after results have completed. Content must fit the native 640×420 panel; do not increase the window. The key design focus is one clear selected file with an abbreviated path and primary/secondary actions.

SCREEN: 03 — 文本工具 · JSON. This is the keyword-mode state of the SAME compact launcher.
PAGE STRUCTURE:
1. Integrated search header: a small “json” command token followed by visible argument text '{"name":"DontsTool","native":true}', magnifier becomes curly-braces tool glyph, small clear/escape affordance at right. The combined input must fit one line with sensible truncation.
2. Section caption “JSON 工具”. First selected result row: title “格式化并复制 JSON”, subtitle a ONE-LINE monospaced formatted-result summary '{ "name": "DontsTool", "native": true }', right action “复制 ↵”. Use 32pt simple braces icon. Second result row: title “压缩并复制 JSON”, subtitle '{"name":"DontsTool","native":true}', right keycap “⌘ ↵”. This second row is the same tool's secondary operation, not a full editor.
3. Under result rows a small unobtrusive hint “未输入内容时，执行后才会读取剪贴板”. Allow natural negative space below; do not fill it with artificial cards, documentation or editors.
4. Footer: left small tool glyph and “JSON”, right “↵ 格式化复制   ⌘↵ 压缩复制   esc 关闭”.
Do not add a multi-line code preview pane, split view, toolbar with save/export, clipboard history or auto-reading indicator. Inline copy success toast may be demonstrated only after an interaction, not in the default screenshot. This screen is about completing a quick text action from the keyboard, not editing a file.

1. Integrated search header with compact “tr” token and query “Stay curious, keep building.”.

05-settings:
Design one native macOS settings window for DontsTool, the existing Swift/AppKit efficiency launcher. Apply the project's Quiet Native design system. All interface copy Simplified Chinese. PLATFORM: macOS desktop, a faithful native settings screenshot exported as HTML, on a 1280×900 presentation canvas.
SCREEN: 05 — 设置 · 通用.
PAGE STRUCTURE:
1. One centered native settings window approximately 820×620pt with normal red/yellow/green macOS traffic-light controls at top left and a compact title “DontsTool 设置”.
2. Left navigation sidebar approximately 172pt with a modest product glyph and name. Navigation icon+labels in order: 通用 (selected), 搜索, 工具, 翻译, 索引, 关于. Footer “⌥ Space 呼出启动器”. This sidebar exists only in the settings window.
3. Main content header “通用”, a short subtitle “按你的习惯，随时呼出。”. Compact grouped native form rows with aligned labels and controls, no oversized cards.
4. Group “启动与快捷键”: row “呼出快捷键”, secondary “在任意应用中显示或隐藏启动器”, a focused shortcut recorder control showing “⌥ Space”; row “登录时启动”, secondary “在登录 Mac 后自动运行”, native toggle switched ON; row “外观”, secondary “跟随 macOS 系统外观”, small system/appearance label. The appearance row is read-only “跟随系统”, not a newly invented app setting.
5. Group “应用索引”: title “已索引 128 个应用” clearly demo content, supporting text “应用列表保存在本机，安装新应用后可手动更新。”, compact button “重新扫描”, shortcut hint “⌘ R”. No fabricated last-sync time, cloud storage, account sign-in, telemetry graph or performance chart.
6. Group “使用说明”: small subdued keyboard rows “↑ ↓ 选择结果”, “↵ 执行操作”, “⌘ ↵ 执行次操作”, “esc 关闭面板”. Keep visual hierarchy quiet. Bottom simple privacy note “设置与使用记录仅保存在本机”.
No web header/hero, no chatbot, plugins store, team workspace, subscription, shortcuts grid or huge section numerals. Use native switch, shortcut-recorder keycaps, separators, form alignment and restrained iconography. Settings content should fit this single window without a full-page scroll.
IMPORTANT UPDATE: use the CURRENT Quiet Light design system for all surfaces and desktop. This is the light system appearance chosen by the user. Add working CSS switch feedback 160ms, 220ms window entrance, hover 100ms and panel close 140ms, prefers-reduced-motion support. Login startup toggle should be a real button with role="switch", aria-checked="true", containing an animated knob. Mark entire window with data-dt-panel and each setting row appropriately. The window has normal native traffic lights and no mocked desktop menu bar. Do not add clipboard history, password tools, AI, accounts or cloud sync. This is a local visual prototype, not actual system settings; no real OS writes.
lightRevision:
Convert ALL FOUR selected DontsTool screens to the project's new Quiet Light design system. The user explicitly dislikes dark UI and wants a light version with designed motion. Preserve each screen's purpose, text, keyboard shortcuts, 640×420 launcher geometry and group order. Completely replace every dark hardcoded background, dark desktop, white-on-dark text, dark keycap, and shadow with the active LIGHT design system; do not leave dark islands. Use native macOS system font first. Keep the panel bright and translucent, content legible. Remove any mocked macOS menubar and fabricated date/time from all canvases. All launcher corners exactly 14pt; header/footer flex-shrink:0, internal results min-height:0 and overflow:auto. In JSON header, render curly braces as a nowrap glyph {} in one line, never vertically wrapped. In initial launcher retain json, tr, uuid, Base64 encoding b64; no password generator. In translation screen replace '目标语言可在偏好设置中自由调整或切换引擎' with '目标语言可在设置中更改', do not invent an engine setting or tr:en syntax.
MOTION IMPLEMENTATION IN EXPORTED HTML: CSS/JS for panel enter 220ms with opacity plus translateY(8px) and scale(.985); close 140ms on Esc; arrow-key selection feedback 140ms; row hover 100ms; result update 120ms with capped short stagger; copy toast 180ms only after user activation; settings switches 160ms. Implement prefers-reduced-motion: reduce to disable translations/scales/stagger and use 1ms transitions. Motion must feel precise and fast, no infinite glow, floating decoration or artificial loading. Add only structural hooks needed for interactive prototype; preserve same compact native product layout. Do not add explanation text or buttons outside the screenshot.
